title: 09. Production & Safety: PII Detection & Masking
summary: PII (Personally Identifiable Information) must never be stored in LLM context, logged, or returned to unauthorized users. PII detection finds it and masking anonymizes it.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > PII (Personally Identifiable Information) must never be stored in LLM context, logged, or returned to unauthorized users. PII detection finds it and masking anonymizes it.

sections.title: PII Detection Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              PII DETECTION — WHAT TO FIND AND MASK              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  PII TYPES AND PATTERNS:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ┌────────────────────┬────────────────────┬──────────────────┐
  │  PII Type          │  Example           │  Regex Pattern   │
  ├────────────────────┼────────────────────┼──────────────────┤
  │  Email             │  user@example.com  │  \S+@\S+\.\S+   │
  │  Phone US          │  +1 (555) 123-4567 │  \+?1?\d{10,11} │
  │  Credit Card       │  4532 1111 1111 111│  \d{4}[\s-]\d{4}│
  │  SSN               │  123-45-6789       │  \d{3}-\d{2}-\d4│
  │  API Key           │  sk-abc123...      │  sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]+│
  │  AWS Key           │  AKIA...           │  AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}│
  │  IP Address        │  192.168.1.1       │  \d{1,3}\.\d...  │
  │  Date of Birth     │  DOB: 01/15/1990   │  DOB:\s*\d+/...  │
  │  Name (heuristic)  │  John Smith        │  [A-Z][a-z]+...  │
  └────────────────────┴────────────────────┴──────────────────┘

  MASKING STRATEGIES:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  STRATEGY 1: FULL REDACTION
  Original: "Contact John Smith at john@example.com"
  Masked:   "Contact [NAME_REDACTED] at [EMAIL_REDACTED]"
  Use when: Strict compliance (HIPAA, GDPR)

  STRATEGY 2: PARTIAL MASKING
  Original: "Card: 4532 1111 1111 1111"
  Masked:   "Card: **** **** **** 1111"
  Use when: User needs to verify their own data

  STRATEGY 3: TOKENIZATION (for RAG pipelines)
  Original: "John Smith, john@example.com"
  Stored:   "PERSON_A82x, EMAIL_K93z@example.com"
  Mapping stored separately, securely.
  Use when: Need to process data but not expose it

  STRATEGY 4: ANONYMIZATION
  Original: "35-year-old male in London"
  Anon:     "30-40 year old person in UK"
  Use when: Analytics/training without individual tracking

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  THE PII PIPELINE:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Input (may have PII)
         │
         ▼
  ┌────────────────────┐
  │  1. Detect PII     │ ← regex + ML classifier
  └────────┬───────────┘
           │
           ▼
  ┌────────────────────┐
  │  2. Assess risk    │ ← GDPR tier? Medical? Financial?
  └────────┬───────────┘
           │
           ▼
  ┌────────────────────┐
  │  3. Mask/Redact    │ ← according to policy
  └────────┬───────────┘
           │
           ▼
  ┌────────────────────┐
  │  4. Log detection  │ ← audit trail
  └────────┬───────────┘
           │
           ▼
  Safe input → LLM processing ✅
```
